title: Character sets
note: Character sheets are not tied to one roleplay. Each character-sheet item expands into the entries listed in characters/<name>/character.json (params.entries: null = all). Stills first: approve an Elena/Ryan entry marked reference before the rest can be drawn; clips need their first/last faces approved.

items.summary: Elena, the senior leader: new full set in Marcus's style (small talk: bored/neutral/interested/delighted + greeting/laugh/checks-phone/leaves clips; project review: skeptical/disapproving).
Ryan, the coworker who blames you: new full set in Marcus's style.
Marcus: only the missing angles, mood faces and the six reaction clips for Saying no (sigh / guilt-trip / relief) and Confessing (reads-phone / goes-steely / exhale), drawn from his existing art.
Sarah: only a 9:16 base, one extra angle and the two faces of her hint moment (concerned, encouraging), in her own style.
